comparison.objective: Extract the center box from a tightly packed cluster while preserving eight neighbors; candidate commissions and locks a compact axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Box task tests non-prehensile neighbor rearrangement, clearance creation, singulation, and placement. Candidate tests hex-key engagement, bimanual counterholding, collar adjustment, setscrew locking, control pressing, and iterative response assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Box task requires the blue cube flat on an 80 mm pad while every brown cube remains flat and continuously on the mat. Candidate requires two safe ≥0.85 J stops within 12 mm and lock retention. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, drift, and witness-torque thresholds.
comparison.reason: Clutter singulation and protected-neighbor handling exercise a different tested ability from force-limited adjuster commissioning and dynamic-cycle validation.
